description: Set a lead's status (new, read, converted, archived or spam) and/or mark it replied. replied=true records that the lead was answered somewhere else (your own mail app, a call): it stamps the time, shows the replied tick on the Inquiries page and moves a new lead to read; replied=false clears it. Pass status, replied, or both. (reply_to_inquiry sends the email and marks it replied by itself.)

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

status.description: A status value — see the tool's description for the allowed set.

name: set_inquiry_status
title: Set Inquiry Status
